Publication bridge now uses configured absolute interpreter and -I installed module; this does not isolate all calculation/source workers. Merged read still launches python3 -m scripts.merged_read_cli from repoRoot; full worker/runtime ownership and trusted interpreter/site-packages provenance remain unaccepted.
dependencyCoverage: Fixed reviewed dependency inventory, not a transitive dependency closure. Covers primary actor/grant policies, merged source authorization, source/principal identity, binding/token/credential rows, worker launch/admission/environment and account/credential configuration. Includes the publication interpreter selector, bridge client and scope; other imported publication readers, annual/manual implementation subgraphs, external Python workers, runtime configuration and deployed ACL require separate acceptance; unchanged listed hashes do not establish authorization correctness.

publicationBridgeReview.implementation: Absolute interpreter path from internal override or TAIKO_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE; rejects relative paths and NUL; -I excludes cwd, PYTHONPATH and user site.
